name: dropcode
description: Send-anywhere style peer-to-peer file transfer over WebRTC

scripts.build:server: esbuild server/src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=server/dist/index.js --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.test:cli: cd cli && go vet ./... && go test -race ./...
